hostBoundary.platform: Required explicit host port used by the public descriptor branch.
hostBoundary.gitBashPath: Resolved by the complete source-derived nullable p() closure and cached with the original undefined-vs-null rule.
hostBoundary.powerShellToolSetting: Optional boolean from the existing typed environment; undefined preserves upstream fallback order.
hostBoundary.feature: Called with upstream feature key and fallback only when earlier upstream branches permit.
hostBoundary.osName: Must be the host platform helper result; no platform inference occurs in this module.
hostBoundary.cache: Existing session cache object returned dynamically after currentSession(); do not capture a replaced cache object.

discovery.existsSync: Injected filesystem existence reader; synthetic in tests.
discovery.findExecutable: Complete source-derived uor closure in executableDiscovery.js with explicit synchronous FS/process ports.
discovery.warn: Injected logging sink; captured in tests.

limitations: Win32 getters, nullable discovery and executable closure are compared with both 2.1.287 Windows architectures under identical injected host ports.
No Windows machine, native executable, filesystem probing, shell launch, credential access or deployment was exercised.
The six raw platform shell descriptor declarations are pinned and recorded; only Win32 raw closures are executed in the differential tests.
The spawnSync bridge preserves fields observed by uor, not unobserved execFileSync error message/stack formatting.
Windows path operations use public node:path.win32; differential cwd${USER_HOME} candidates use absolute Windows paths, not actual Windows drive-relative environment acceptance.

executableBoundary.cache: Original WeakMap owner dynamically uses ports.getCache(), the current context runtime cache object.
executableBoundary.spawn: Raw execFileSync call is bridged to public node:child_process.spawnSync; stdout and status/signal/error-code fields are retained.
executableBoundary.environment: Live getEnv() and cwd() ports; public os.homedir() supplies the canonical-alias source dependency.
executableBoundary.logger: uor has no logger call; the already restored Git Bash p() warning sink remains its own port.

executableEvidence.rawOracle: Complete raw-file AST declarations re-evaluated in module-local VM closures; generated executable JS is not the oracle.
